domains.name: Record to Report
domains.description: Close the books, reconcile balances and produce statutory and management reporting.

domains.name: Order to Cash
domains.description: Bill customers, apply cash, manage credit exposure and collect receivables.

domains.name: Procure to Pay
domains.description: Onboard suppliers, process invoices and settle payables.

domains.name: Financial Planning & Analysis
domains.description: Budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis against plan.

domains.name: Treasury
domains.description: Cash positioning, liquidity management and FX risk.

domains.name: Tax & Compliance
domains.description: Indirect tax filings and internal control assurance.

data_objects.name: Journal Entry
data_objects.description: A debit/credit posting to the general ledger.

data_objects.name: GL Account
data_objects.description: A chart-of-accounts line against which postings are made.

data_objects.name: Trial Balance
data_objects.description: Period-end balances across all GL accounts.

data_objects.name: Reconciliation
data_objects.description: Evidence that a balance agrees to an independent source.

data_objects.name: Legal Entity
data_objects.description: A consolidating company in the group structure.

data_objects.name: Financial Statement
data_objects.description: Statutory or management reporting output for a period.

data_objects.name: Customer
data_objects.description: A party billed for goods or services.

data_objects.name: Sales Order
data_objects.description: A confirmed customer order awaiting fulfilment and billing.

data_objects.name: Customer Invoice
data_objects.description: A receivable raised against a customer.

data_objects.name: Remittance Advice
data_objects.description: Customer notification of what a payment settles.

data_objects.name: Cash Receipt
data_objects.description: Funds received into a bank account.

data_objects.name: Credit Limit
data_objects.description: Approved exposure ceiling for a customer.

data_objects.name: Dunning Case
data_objects.description: An open collections action against an overdue receivable.

data_objects.name: Vendor
data_objects.description: An approved supplier of goods or services.

data_objects.name: Purchase Order
data_objects.description: A commitment to buy from a vendor.

data_objects.name: Goods Receipt
data_objects.description: Confirmation that ordered goods or services were delivered.

data_objects.name: Vendor Invoice
data_objects.description: A payable raised by a supplier.

data_objects.name: Payment Run
data_objects.description: A batch of outbound settlements to vendors.

data_objects.name: Expense Report
data_objects.description: Employee-submitted reimbursable spend.

data_objects.name: Bank Statement
data_objects.description: Daily transaction feed from a banking partner.

data_objects.name: Cash Position
data_objects.description: Consolidated available liquidity by currency and entity.

data_objects.name: FX Exposure
data_objects.description: Net currency exposure requiring hedge consideration.

data_objects.name: Hedge Contract
data_objects.description: A derivative booked to offset an exposure.

data_objects.name: Budget
data_objects.description: The approved annual financial plan.

data_objects.name: Forecast
data_objects.description: A rolling projection superseding the budget.

data_objects.name: Cost Centre
data_objects.description: An organisational unit accountable for spend.

data_objects.name: Variance
data_objects.description: A gap between actual and plan requiring explanation.

data_objects.name: Tax Return
data_objects.description: A periodic filing to a tax authority.

data_objects.name: Tax Code
data_objects.description: The rate and treatment applied to a transaction line.

data_objects.name: Control
data_objects.description: A documented check mitigating a financial reporting risk.

data_objects.name: Control Evidence
data_objects.description: Artefact demonstrating a control operated effectively.

workflows.name: Month-End Close
workflows.description: Coordinate the group close from sub-ledger cut-off through to signed-off consolidated results.
workflows.risk_notes: Late sub-ledger cut-off from P2P is the single largest driver of close overrun.

steps.name: Sub-ledger cut-off
steps.description: Freeze AP, AR and payroll sub-ledgers and confirm no further postings.

steps.name: Accruals and prepayments
steps.description: Post recurring accruals, releases and prepayment amortisation.

steps.name: Intercompany matching
steps.description: Match and eliminate intercompany balances across legal entities.

steps.name: Balance sheet reconciliations
steps.description: Complete and certify reconciliations for all in-scope accounts.

steps.name: Flux analysis
steps.description: Explain month-on-month movements above threshold to the controller.

steps.name: Consolidation run
steps.description: Execute group consolidation including FX translation.

steps.name: Controller sign-off
steps.description: Formal approval of results and release to management reporting.

workflows.name: Balance Sheet Reconciliation
workflows.description: Substantiate every balance sheet account against independent supporting evidence.
workflows.risk_notes: High-risk accounts still rely on spreadsheet support outside BlackLine.

steps.name: Auto-certify low-risk accounts
steps.description: Rules engine certifies zero-balance and immaterial accounts.

steps.name: Pull supporting evidence
steps.description: Extract sub-ledger and bank support for remaining accounts.

steps.name: Prepare reconciliations
steps.description: Reconcile balances and document reconciling items with ageing.

steps.name: Investigate aged items
steps.description: Clear or explain reconciling items older than 60 days.

steps.name: Independent review
steps.description: Reviewer challenges support and approves certification.

workflows.name: Customer Invoicing
workflows.description: Convert fulfilled orders into accurate, tax-compliant invoices delivered to the customer.
workflows.risk_notes: Manual pricing overrides on enterprise deals remain the main source of credit notes.

steps.name: Collect billable events
steps.description: Pull fulfilled orders and usage records ready to bill.

steps.name: Validate pricing and terms
steps.description: Check contract rates, discounts and billing schedule.

steps.name: Determine tax treatment
steps.description: Apply jurisdiction tax codes via the tax engine.

steps.name: Generate invoice
steps.description: Create the receivable and post to the sub-ledger.

steps.name: Exception review
steps.description: Review invoices held by validation rules before release.

steps.name: Deliver to customer
steps.description: Dispatch via e-invoicing network, portal or email.

workflows.name: Cash Application
workflows.description: Match incoming customer payments to open receivables and clear the ledger.
workflows.risk_notes: Unapplied cash spikes when customers pay by consolidated remittance without invoice references.

steps.name: Import bank transactions
steps.description: Load prior-day statements from all banking partners.

steps.name: Auto-match receipts
steps.description: Machine matching of receipts to open invoices.

steps.name: Resolve unmatched cash
steps.description: Chase remittance detail and manually apply residual receipts.

steps.name: Handle short pays and deductions
steps.description: Route disputed deductions to the relevant business owner.

steps.name: Post and clear
steps.description: Post applications and clear the customer sub-ledger.

workflows.name: Collections & Dunning
workflows.description: Pursue overdue receivables through a risk-tiered contact strategy to escalation.
workflows.risk_notes: Strategy is uniform across segments; strategic accounts receive the same dunning as low-value ones.

steps.name: Refresh ageing
steps.description: Rebuild the receivables ageing and overdue worklist.

steps.name: Segment and prioritise
steps.description: Rank accounts by exposure, risk score and days overdue.

steps.name: Execute contact strategy
steps.description: Issue reminders and make collection calls per tier.

steps.name: Log promises to pay
steps.description: Record commitments and diarise follow-up.

steps.name: Escalate and provision
steps.description: Refer non-responsive accounts and propose bad debt provision.

workflows.name: Customer Credit Review
workflows.description: Assess and periodically re-assess customer creditworthiness and exposure limits.
workflows.risk_notes: Limits for mid-market accounts have not been refreshed within policy for two cycles.

steps.name: Identify accounts due
steps.description: Select customers due periodic review or breaching limits.

steps.name: Gather credit data
steps.description: Pull bureau scores, payment history and exposure.

steps.name: Recommend limit
steps.description: Model the proposed limit and payment terms.

steps.name: Approve limit
steps.description: Apply delegated authority matrix and record approval.

workflows.name: Vendor Invoice Processing
workflows.description: Capture, match and post supplier invoices ready for payment.
workflows.risk_notes: Goods receipt is often posted late, so match failures cluster at period end.

steps.name: Capture invoice
steps.description: OCR and digitise inbound supplier invoices.

steps.name: Validate vendor and bank detail
steps.description: Confirm the vendor is approved and bank detail unchanged.

steps.name: Three-way match
steps.description: Match invoice to purchase order and goods receipt.

steps.name: Resolve match exceptions
steps.description: Chase requisitioners for receipts or price approvals.

steps.name: Apply tax treatment
steps.description: Determine recoverable and irrecoverable input tax.

steps.name: Post to ledger
steps.description: Post the payable and route for payment scheduling.

workflows.name: Vendor Payment Run
workflows.description: Select, approve and release scheduled supplier payments.
workflows.risk_notes: Payment release depends on two named approvers; cover during leave is thin.

steps.name: Build proposal
steps.description: Select due invoices by due date, entity and currency.

steps.name: Screen for duplicates and sanctions
steps.description: Run duplicate detection and sanctions screening.

steps.name: Confirm funding
steps.description: Check cleared funds by currency against the position.

steps.name: Dual approval
steps.description: Two authorised approvers release the payment file.

steps.name: Transmit and confirm
steps.description: Send the file to the bank and reconcile acknowledgements.

workflows.name: Vendor Onboarding
workflows.description: Qualify, verify and activate a new supplier in the vendor master.
workflows.risk_notes: Bank detail verification is a manual callback with inconsistent evidence retention.

steps.name: Intake request
steps.description: Business submits a supplier request with justification.

steps.name: Due diligence screening
steps.description: Sanctions, adverse media and beneficial ownership checks.

steps.name: Verify bank detail
steps.description: Independent callback to a verified contact on file.

steps.name: Tax and compliance data
steps.description: Collect tax registration and withholding status.

steps.name: Approve and activate
steps.description: Create the vendor master record under segregated access.

workflows.name: Employee Expense Reimbursement
workflows.description: Review, approve and reimburse employee-submitted expenses under policy.
workflows.risk_notes: Low value, high volume; audit sampling rather than full review is the accepted approach.

steps.name: Submit claim
steps.description: Employee submits receipts and coding.

steps.name: Policy engine check
steps.description: Automated policy and duplicate-receipt checks.

steps.name: Line manager approval
steps.description: Cost centre owner approves the spend.

steps.name: Audit sample review
steps.description: Risk-based sample reviewed against receipts.

steps.name: Reimburse
steps.description: Include in the payment run and post to the ledger.

workflows.name: Rolling Forecast
workflows.description: Refresh the 12-month rolling forecast with business input and challenge.
workflows.risk_notes: Cost centre owners submit late, compressing the challenge window to under a day.

steps.name: Load actuals
steps.description: Push closed-period actuals into the planning model.

steps.name: Seed driver assumptions
steps.description: Update volume, price and headcount drivers.

steps.name: Collect business submissions
steps.description: Cost centre owners submit their forecast positions.

steps.name: Challenge and consolidate
steps.description: Challenge submissions against trend and consolidate.

steps.name: Publish forecast pack
steps.description: Distribute the approved forecast and commentary.

workflows.name: Budget Variance Analysis
workflows.description: Explain actual-to-plan variances above threshold and agree corrective actions.
workflows.risk_notes: Commentary quality varies widely by cost centre owner.

steps.name: Generate variance report
steps.description: Compute actual versus budget and forecast by cost centre.

steps.name: Apply materiality filter
steps.description: Isolate variances above absolute and percentage thresholds.

steps.name: Request commentary
steps.description: Route material variances to cost centre owners.

steps.name: Review and agree actions
steps.description: Business review meeting agrees corrective actions.

workflows.name: Daily Cash Positioning
workflows.description: Establish the group cash position and fund the day's obligations.
workflows.risk_notes: One regional bank still delivers statements by manual download.

steps.name: Import balances
steps.description: Pull opening balances across all bank accounts.

steps.name: Layer in known flows
steps.description: Add scheduled receipts, payroll and payment runs.

steps.name: Determine funding actions
steps.description: Decide sweeps, borrowings and investments by currency.

steps.name: Approve and execute
steps.description: Approve movements and instruct the banks.

workflows.name: FX Exposure & Hedging
workflows.description: Quantify net currency exposure and execute hedges within policy limits.
workflows.risk_notes: Exposure data depends on forecast quality from FP&A; late forecasts delay hedge execution.

steps.name: Aggregate exposures
steps.description: Consolidate balance sheet and forecast exposures by currency.

steps.name: Compare to policy limits
steps.description: Test net exposure against approved hedge ratios.

steps.name: Execute hedges
steps.description: Deal forwards or swaps with panel counterparties.

steps.name: Document hedge designation
steps.description: Prepare hedge accounting documentation and effectiveness testing.

workflows.name: Indirect Tax (VAT) Filing
workflows.description: Prepare, review and submit periodic indirect tax returns by jurisdiction.
workflows.risk_notes: Filing deadlines are statutory; a missed submission carries automatic penalties.

steps.name: Extract transaction data
steps.description: Pull taxable transactions by jurisdiction and tax code.

steps.name: Run validation rules
steps.description: Test for missing or inconsistent tax determinations.

steps.name: Resolve exceptions
steps.description: Correct misclassified transactions and post adjustments.

steps.name: Reconcile to ledger
steps.description: Agree the return to the GL tax control accounts.

steps.name: Review and submit
steps.description: Manager approval and submission to the authority.

workflows.name: SOX Control Testing
workflows.description: Test the design and operating effectiveness of key financial reporting controls.
workflows.risk_notes: Evidence collection is largely manual; testers chase artefacts by email.

steps.name: Confirm control scope
steps.description: Agree the in-scope control population for the cycle.

steps.name: Select samples
steps.description: Draw statistically valid samples per control.

steps.name: Collect evidence
steps.description: Request and chase supporting artefacts from control owners.

steps.name: Perform testing
steps.description: Execute test procedures and document conclusions.

steps.name: Log and track deficiencies
steps.description: Raise findings, agree remediation and track to closure.

workflows.name: Lease Accounting (IFRS 16)
workflows.description: Maintain the lease register and post right-of-use asset and liability movements.
workflows.risk_notes: Currently spreadsheet-driven and undocumented; being formalised ahead of system migration.

steps.name: Capture new and modified leases
steps.description: Collect lease contracts and modifications from the business.

steps.name: Calculate ROU and liability
steps.description: Compute right-of-use asset and lease liability schedules.

steps.name: Post monthly movements
steps.description: Post depreciation, interest and remeasurements.

steps.name: Reconcile lease register
steps.description: Agree the register to the ledger and disclosure note.
